description: A shell script managing RDM application downloads, verification, notifications, and package uninstallation within a device management system.

methods.name: checkAppDownload
methods.description: Verifies if the app's manifest and data are present in the media directory.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification about the download status via IARM event sender.

methods.name: updatePkgStatus
methods.description: Updates the package status and broadcasts it.

methods.name: uninstallPackages
methods.description: Uninstalls packages not listed in the current manifest.
